name: @isoloir/web
description: isoloir in the browser: keys, registration, ballots, receipts and results over Nostr relays and a static mirror, on the protocol's own Rust compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.wasm:web: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" wasm-pack build ../crates/wasm --target web --out-dir ../../js/wasm/web --out-name isoloir_wasm --release && rm -f wasm/web/.gitignore
scripts.wasm:node: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" wasm-pack build ../crates/wasm --target nodejs --out-dir ../../js/wasm/node --out-name isoloir_wasm --release -- --features dev && rm -f wasm/node/.gitignore
scripts.wasm: npm run wasm:web && npm run wasm:node
